title: ASSERT: A Measurement Pipeline for GenAI Audits
abstract: arXiv:2608.13840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audits of generative AI (GenAI) systems often summarize behavior as a reported rate: how often the audited system complies with policy. Researchers and stakeholders use that rate to compare systems, track regressions, and gate deployment. A reported rate reflects both the system under audit and the measurement choices behind it, so a change in the rate can leave it unclear whether the system or those choices moved. We introduce ASSERT, a specification-driven measurement pipeline for GenAI audits that ties each reported rate to a written specification of the measurement choices used to produce it. ASSERT helps draft a behavioral rubric and test cases, then runs the audit against a GenAI system and returns a reported rate. In a case study on conversational deception, we observe that the reported rate moves substantially with the dialogue setup, the simulated user, the judge, and the evidence bar for non-compliance. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13840v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：生成式AI（GenAI）系统的审计通常将行为总结为报告率：被审计系统遵守政策的频率。研究人员和利益相关者使用该比率来比较系统、跟踪回归和门控部署。报告率既反映了被审计系统，也反映了其背后的测量选择，因此比率的变化可能使人不清楚是系统还是选择发生了变化。我们引入了ASSERT，一种针对GenAI审计的规范驱动测量管道，它将每个报告率与用于生成它的测量选择的书面规范相关联。ASSERT帮助起草行为准则和测试用例，然后对GenAI系统运行审计并返回报告率。在对话欺骗的案例研究中，我们观察到报告率随对话设置、模拟用户、评判者和不合规证据标准的变化而显著移动。这些测量选择...
tldr: ASSERT提出了一种规范驱动的测量管道，通过将GenAI审计的报告率与测量选择明确关联，解决了报告率变化来源不清晰的问题，并在对话欺骗案例中验证了测量选择对结果的影响。
en_tdlr: ASSERT introduces a specification-driven measurement pipeline that ties GenAI audit reported rates to explicit measurement choices, clarifying the source of rate changes and demonstrating substantial impacts in a conversational deception case study.
